integrity: Analytic proof and replayed deterministic numerical cross-check are included; numerical checks are finite corroboration only. Literature priority is provisional, and no independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent parameter-uniform points on a symmetric parabola arc; results describe two near-threshold asymptotics and marked limits, not all finite-width probabilities. Arclength sampling is excluded.
title: Two sharp Fermat–Torricelli phase thresholds for random parabolic triangles
